entry_points.text: Single and scatter syncs order processor and bounce handling with extra global step toward CPU; unmap skips management or explicitly coherent requests.

exports.text: Page alloc records a noncoherent entry and free validates it, inert when disabled or reservation fails. Fallback header supplies no-op map, unmap, scatter, coherent, sync and page helpers. Early setup stores a bounded driver filter, logs when nonempty and succeeds. Entries carry type, device, origins, length and direction.

Helpers compute required mask, bus-to-page, coherent test and encrypted or plain choice from forced-decryption state. Plain serves unencrypted, protected serves rest. Coherence needs successful translation inside smaller nonzero mask or limit. Swiotlb helper allocates a page then revalidates, returning it on failure.

Bounce alloc checks shared mode, reserves aligned slots and returns the page; failures warn, release and fail. Pool alloc scans zone-ordered candidates, validates with refund, refills low pools, zeroes and returns first fit. Release and ownership probes free via owner and report status; guessing skips absent pools and warns when empty.

Coherent alloc rounds size, picks path, gets pages, decrypts, alt-maps or makes uncached, zeroes and translates, unwinding on failure. Free reverses path and restores encryption with warn on mismatch. Paged pair uses atomic when nonblocking else bounce or direct, clears and restores unless bounce or pool owned. Contiguous precedes downgraded buddy; no-map without shared uses cookie, nonblocking remap or shared uses atomic.

Single maps check bounce and capability, share management ranges, use bounce or sync unless skipped, else error token. Scatter maps host entries, keeps bus entries, flushes incoherent and unwinds without sync on failure. Bounce maps acquire backing, validate and sync; release needs ownership. Table maps reject bad pools, align and precopy; unmap syncs unless skipped then frees or destroys transient. Max subtracts alignment penalty.

Remap joins pages into one coherent range; bad teardown warns. Tables use one rounded entry; mmap checks coherence, protection, pools and offsets. Masks accept wide values else translated limits; range scans by frame, RAM walk checks coverage, max uses bounce when active. Incoherent or bounce addresses need sync; offset rejects existing maps and installs one shift.

Addressing is limited when effective mask is below required; required prefers direct needs else defaults; direct applies without translation when no custom ops or bypass with sufficient mask. Protection keeps caller view when coherent else picks combined views and decrypted or encrypted form. Dummy fails maps, supports nothing and warns on release.

hazards.text: Protection changes can fail; decrypt or re-encrypt failure warns rate-limited and leaks to avoid mismatched protection.
Debug and direct headers use once-only guards; benchmark logs prefix with the module name.

Bounce or pool exhaustion, sharing or encryption mismatch and missing pools report errors with diagnostics. Misaligned origins warn once, release and fail. Large alignment can block near-maximum requests.

invariants.text: Zone comes from smaller nonzero mask or limit: low ceiling gives lowest zone, 32-bit gives middle, else none. Low ceiling is 24-bit and fixed after init. Scatter sync and release are inert; single device sync handles bounce then arch sync with flush for incoherent.

Slot count rounds up, address shifts index plus base, offsets mask in segments, maxima come from boundary masks, areas wrap and cap by segment, and alignment merges device minimum, caller mask and granularity.

Transient, used and high-water counters have active and inert builds. Emergency pools link to the device and count; failed searches schedule reclaim. Default search starts from processor-derived area with shared or encrypted base, probes cyclically and returns -1 when full. Global decrement either forwards or does nothing.

Bounce skips invalid origins, flushes incoherent inbound, adjusts offset, truncates overlong with warn, copies under irq save for high memory else directly and clears sanitizer inbound. Transient helpers have active and inert forms. Usage reads high-water when tracking, else sums per-area use.

locks.text: Reservation scans from current processor, grows and tries emergency pools when full; oversize or disabled fails. Search enforces granularity and bounds, fails without space and updates runs. Area ops hold area spin with irq saved, insert holds device lock, traversal uses read-side guard. Zero demand or bad area is fatal.

Release derives start and count, validates area as fatal, then under irq-saved area lock rewrites runs, invalidates metadata, merges predecessors and decrements use. Removal unlinks under device lock then reclaims outside.

state_machines.text: Single granule counts pages and scatter counts entries. Prepare allocates with cleanup on failure; init fills except device-to-memory; mapping uses standard calls with error logs. Iteration runs allocate, stain, map, unmap and free; alloc failure aborts and unmap follows every successful map.

structs.text: Run state holds params, device, debug entry, direction and atomic timing and loop counters. Ops bundle groups prepare, cleanup, init, map and unmap. Single params give device, address, buffer, count and direction; scatter adds table and trailing buffers.

Pool stores sharing, bases, quotas and bounds; area stores lock and use; slot stores list, origin, size and pad. Init zeroes, sets lists and invalid origins. Creation caps slabs and halves to minimum on failure. Reservation uses atomic pools when nonblocking and shared, else low or 32-bit zone with downgrades. Over-ceiling rejects, encryption failures leak; release returns pool-owned or restores encryption.
